answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 46799 Country: Pakistan Title: Sawm Question: I was talking to my friend and I told him that ihtilam does not break fast but masturbation breaks the fast, so he told me that he did not knew that masturbation breaks the fast and that he had done masturbation few times in Ramadan during fasting (not knowing that it breaks the fast), so now what he has to do? Should he make the qaza of those 3 or 4 fasts in which he masturbated? Can he pay kaffarah instead of having fasts? Please tell in detail what are his liabilities? Also note that it was not in his knowledge that fast would break due to this act. Answer ID: 46799 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1109/859/D=10/1434) The qadha of all those fasts shall be wajib during which he masturbated in the state of fast. It is not lawful to pay fidyah; rather it is necessary to keep fast. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
